query:
WITH query_embedding AS (
            SELECT value
            FROM embeddings
            WHERE id = $1
        )
        SELECT
            te.id AS "embedding_id!: Uuid",
            te.value <=> qe.value AS "distance!: f64"
        FROM tagged_embeddings te
        CROSS JOIN query_embedding qe
        WHERE
            te.id != $1
            AND te.tag_hash = $2
        ORDER BY "distance!: f64", te.id
        LIMIT $3;
